summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 season with just one week until kick-off, having welcomed several new signings and a returning player to bolster the squad. The Ramblers are looking to push for promotion and have invested in three brand new kits, with sponsorship opportunities still available for interested partners. Recent preparations have gone well, though a recent friendly against St Helens showed there's still work to do, with the visitors clinical in their finishing.
